''See also: [[Akura Grace Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Akura clan{{!}}Akura [[Grace]] is a skilled [[Underlord]] and a member of the [[Akura clan]]. A descendant of the lineage, she possesses a physical appearance reminiscent of the [[Monarch Malice]], characterized by thick, dark hair and a beautiful, full-figured build. Although she did not successfully bond with any of the [[Books of Seven Pages]], she has achieved significant proficiency in her [[shadow Path]] and is a capable swordswoman, typically wielding a long, curved, single-edged saber. [[Grace]] served as the leader of the [[Akura backup team]] during a [[tournament]], a group assembled to replace the destroyed [[Rising Earth team]]. Under her leadership, the team performed respectably, with [[Grace]] maintaining a thirty-second place ranking before she was eventually eliminated. Her elimination occurred after her team encountered a group of [[dragons]] prior to reaching [[Lindon]], and she was unable to secure a crown in the time remaining. Within her family, [[Grace]] was considered a highly talented individual and the pride of her parents, [[Akura Earnest]] and Kiya, with high expectations that she would increase the clan's prestige.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Akura clan{{!}}Akura [[Grace]] is a young woman whose bodies are remade in [[soulfire]]. She carries a single-edged, lightly curved saber as her weapon.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|As an [[Underlady]] and a warrior, she serves as the leader of the [[Akura backup team]]. She is an [[Underlord]] candidate within the [[Akura clan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|She has achieved mastery over her [[shadow Path]] and her [[sword]]. Her combat skills are utilized in her role as a warrior.}}
